toolsPreview.name: verify_receipt
toolsPreview.description: Verify a provenance receipt (F-037): recomputes the HMAC signature, checks the intra-receipt chain linkage, and — when the receipt carries an external anchor reference — confirms it against the published F-028 anchor. Returns {valid:true, anchor:"verified"|"pending"|"unverified"} or {valid:false, reason:"signature_mismatch"|"chain_link_broken"|"anchor_mismatch"|"malformed"}. Tamper-evident; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: entity_search
toolsPreview.description: Search a company/person name across ALL ledgers (sanctions, licenses, recalls, pharma, bids, subsidies, grants, public comments, ordinances, ToS, real-estate, land-price). Returns hits grouped per ledger, each with matchedField, a summary, detailUrl and ledgerVerified (hash-chain integrity). ledgerVerified proves the records were not altered after they were recorded here — NOT the truth of the underlying data.

toolsPreview.name: temporal_query
toolsPreview.description: Reconstruct what a ledger item (or items matching a query) officially said AS OF a past date T, by replaying the kept event history. Returns each item's point-in-time state plus an F-037 provenance receipt (observed_at = the state's effective time). existence:false with a first_seen receipt when the item did not yet exist at T; latest state with as_of_clamped:false when T is in the future. Read-only; price 0.0.

toolsPreview.name: kyb_report
toolsPreview.description: Turn a company/entity name into a structured English KYB / due-diligence report for foreign-inbound buyers. Aggregates cross-ledger hits (administrative sanctions, licenses, public bids, recalls, etc.) via entity_search, summarizes them (counts + deterministic risk_flags), and attaches an F-037 provenance receipt to EACH hit so the screening is auditable. No model-invented facts: every asserted fact originates from a ledger hit and carries a receipt. Informational only; not legal advice. Price 0.0.

toolsPreview.name: alerts_create_watch

Price 0.0.

toolsPreview.name: carbon_estimate_shipping_emissions
toolsPreview.description: Estimate freight CO2e (kg) from weight, distance and transport mode using embedded GLEC/DEFRA-order emission factors. Pure compute; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: carbon_estimate_compute_emissions
toolsPreview.description: Estimate electricity CO2e (kg) from energy use (kWh) and a regional grid-intensity factor (defaults to the IEA world average). Pure compute; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: carbon_estimate_travel_emissions
toolsPreview.description: Estimate passenger-travel CO2e (kg) from distance and travel mode using embedded per-passenger-km factors. Pure compute; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: carbon_estimate_offset_estimate
toolsPreview.description: Estimate voluntary-market offset cost (USD) and tree- / forest-year equivalents for a given kg CO2e, using published constants. Pure compute; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: carbon_estimate_emission_factor
toolsPreview.description: Look up the published emission factor (value, unit, category) for a named activity key (e.g. shipping_air, electricity_global, travel_car, gasoline, beef). Pure compute; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: email_verify_verify_syntax
toolsPreview.description: Validate and normalize an email address (syntax/structure only): returns valid, normalized address, local-part and domain, plus a reason on failure. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: email_verify_check_mx
toolsPreview.description: List MX records (exchange + priority, sorted) for a domain via free DNS-over-HTTPS to gauge mail deliverability. Accepts a bare domain or a full email address. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: email_verify_detect_disposable
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a domain is a known disposable / throwaway email provider against a bundled list. Accepts a bare domain or a full email address. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: email_verify_check_spf
toolsPreview.description: Fetch and parse the SPF policy from domain TXT records via DNS-over-HTTPS: presence, raw record, all-qualifier (strict/softfail/neutral/pass) and includes. Accepts a bare domain or a full email address. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: email_verify_role_account
toolsPreview.description: Detect whether an email local-part is a role/group account (e.g. info, support, admin) against a bundled list. Accepts a full email address or a bare localPart. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: ip_reputation_classify_ip
toolsPreview.description: Classify an IPv4/IPv6 address into special-use categories (public, private, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, reserved, etc.) from bundled IANA special-use ranges. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: ip_reputation_reverse_dns
toolsPreview.description: Resolve the reverse-DNS (PTR) hostname(s) for an IP via free DNS-over-HTTPS. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: ip_reputation_asn_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Look up origin ASN, network name, prefix and country for an IP via Team Cymru origin lookup (DoH) plus RDAP. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: ip_reputation_detect_datacenter
toolsPreview.description: Heuristically detect whether an IP belongs to a datacenter/hosting range using bundled CIDR lists. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: ip_reputation_risk_score
toolsPreview.description: Transparent heuristic IP risk score (0-100) combining classification, datacenter and reverse-DNS signals; every contribution is returned in the rationale. Informational only. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: fx_tax_convert
toolsPreview.description: Convert an amount between currencies using free, keyless public FX rates (Frankfurter/ECB), fetched on demand. Returns the rate and converted amount. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: fx_tax_vat_calc
toolsPreview.description: Compute VAT for an amount in a given country from built-in VAT rate tables: net, VAT and gross, standard or reduced rate, treating the amount as VAT-inclusive or exclusive. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: fx_tax_vat_validate
toolsPreview.description: Validate the structural format of an EU VAT number (country prefix + national pattern). Format check only; no VIES call. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: fx_tax_sales_tax
toolsPreview.description: Look up the sales-tax rate for a region from built-in tables and, if an amount is given, compute net/tax/gross. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: fx_tax_list_rates
toolsPreview.description: List all built-in VAT and sales-tax rate tables (country/region, rate, type). Deterministic; no input. Pure; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: cve_lookup_get_cve
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single CVE record by id from the free NVD CVE API 2.0: description, CVSS, published/modified dates and references. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: cve_lookup_search_cve
toolsPreview.description: Keyword-search CVEs via the free NVD CVE API 2.0, returning id, base score, severity and published date. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: cve_lookup_cvss_parse
toolsPreview.description: Parse a CVSS v3.0/3.1 vector string into base score, severity and per-metric labels. Fully deterministic; no network I/O; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: cve_lookup_package_advisory
toolsPreview.description: Look up known vulnerabilities for a package via the free OSV.dev API, optionally filtered to a specific version. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: cve_lookup_severity_summary
toolsPreview.description: Fetch multiple CVEs (from NVD) and aggregate a severity distribution and worst-case summary for the set. Read-only; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: holiday_calendar_is_holiday
toolsPreview.description: Determine whether an ISO date is a public holiday for a country (US/GB/JP/DE) from a built-in rule-based dataset; returns the holiday name when matched. Pure/offline; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: holiday_calendar_next_business_day
toolsPreview.description: Compute the business day N steps from an ISO date, skipping weekends and country holidays (negative offset goes backward). Pure/offline; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: holiday_calendar_business_days_between
toolsPreview.description: Count business days between two ISO dates, excluding weekends and country holidays. Pure/offline; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: holiday_calendar_list_holidays
toolsPreview.description: List the public holidays for a country in a given year from the built-in dataset. Pure/offline; price 0.0 (free).

toolsPreview.name: holiday_calendar_tz_convert
toolsPreview.description: Convert a wall-clock datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM(:SS)?) from one IANA timezone to another using the platform Intl database. Pure/offline; price 0.0 (free).
